text:
sara: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need a repeatable simulation and clear owners for blast-radius reductions + auto-rollback criteria. Reposting notes from the retro.
aj: +1. Proposed deliverables: simulation harness, default flag sampling cap, auto-rollback policy draft, and an ops playbook for emergency rollbacks.
kevin: I can own the simulation harness. Will spin up a synthetic workload and run a blast-radius sweep (varying sample_rate and feature mix).
tanvi: I'll take the auto-rollback policy doc and implement feature-flag gating in the client libs. Need to align on abort thresholds and quarantine timer.
mike: Do we have perf metrics to feed into sim? I need tail latency, error-rate, and p95/p99 to model user impact.
sara: Yes — use the rollout latency dashboard (/metrics/rollout/latency) and the sampling traces. I'll paste the query in a follow-up thread.
kevin: sketch for the sim command (local dev):
```
# run 3x sweeps: sample_rate, concurrency, error-inject
python tools/simulate_rollout.py --config sim/configs/blast_radius.yaml --sweeps 3
```
deploy-bot: system: New simulation job queued: sim-2109876570 — status: queued
aj: For sampling defaults, propose: max_sample_rate=0.05 for initial rollouts, quarantine_timer=5m, and abort_on_error_rate=0.02. That keeps blast radius small by default.
kevin: I'll add a configurable `blast_radius` param (percentage of users) and a `quarantine_timer` to the sim harness so we can iterate quickly.
tanvi: timeline? can we aim for PRs by EOD Wed? I can then wire the client-side gating into the infra team test run.
sara: Owners + deadlines: kevin (simulation) — PR by Wed 03/27; tanvi (policy + client changes) — PR by Fri 03/29; aj (ops playbook + runbook) — writeup by Mon 03/31. Mike will validate telemetry and run the dry-run.
mike: I'll schedule a 30-min dry-run on staging next Thu and capture metrics. Will also add a perf test to CI.
aj: TODO list to track here:
1) sim harness repo + initial config
2) default sampling config change (global policy)
3) rollout SLO/abort thresholds (p95/p99 tail, error rate)
4) telemetry tags on flags + tracing hooks
5) ops playbook entry for auto-rollback and manual quarantine
sara: tagging @kevin @tanvi — ping this thread when PRs created. :eyes: If anyone hits a blocker we can reassign.
kevin: ack — starting branch `sim/blast-radius` now, will post a draft PR with basic sweeps.
tanvi: ack — opening RFC in docs repo and I'll link it here for review.
deploy-bot: reminder: oncall runbook updated: https://internal/ops/runbooks/rollouts — please review the new auto-rollback checklist.
aj: small note — we should add a canary traffic cap feature to the console (slider + hard cap) so PMs can set a strict upper bound during experiments.
sara: good call. adding console cap to the scope and assigning to product infra for follow-up. We'll surface estimates of unit-cost impact in the PR.
kevin: one more item: simulate region failover combinations (region A degrade + flag on region B) — will add to the sim matrix.
sara: great. thanks everyone. we'll review progress in next week's eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
